_note: FR-FOOD-7: household and Indian portion units in grams, shared by the food library and the diary. A liquid in ml counts as the same number of grams (close for milk, juices, dal and curries). Foods can override a unit with their own gram weight (a samosa, a dosa).

katori.label: 1 katori
katori.note: standard steel bowl of dal, sabzi or curry

small-katori.label: 1 small katori
small-katori.note: curd, raita, sweets like kheer or halwa

plate.label: 1 plate
plate.note: a plate of rice, biryani, poha or upma

chai-cup.label: 1 cup
chai-cup.note: a cup of chai or coffee (150 ml)

piece.label: 1 piece
piece.note: default when a food has no own piece weight
